gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-bengali: Ozone draws every stroke like a compass pencil, one thickness throughout. Noto Serif Bengali sits underneath with slightly thinner hairlines and trimmed ascenders, so a long passage reads refined and bookish.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-devanagar: Ozone's strokes look bent from a single paperclip, uniform and technical. Noto Serif Devanagari underneath is a literary serif with short ascenders and a big lowercase body, so a long passage settles into a restrained, classic rhythm.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-dives-aku: Refined is the word for Noto Serif Dives Akuru, whose curves carry a faint swell like pulled taffy. And Ozone above it keeps every stroke flat and untapered, so the display heading and serif body feel like two different hands.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-dogra: Ozone shows no difference between its up strokes and side strokes, giving the heading a geometric, technical flatness. Noto Serif Dogra, a serif, reads bookish, with a soft thick-thin rhythm over a long passage.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-ethiopic: Wire-flat and geometric, with a g drawn in one unchanging line. And Noto Serif Ethiopic, a text serif, brings words that read as solid blocks, a bookish steadiness that Ozone's uniform strokes set off nicely.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-georgian: Noto Serif Georgian reads literary and authoritative, its tightly swollen lowercase held in subdued contrast. Ozone, by comparison, runs a steady line with no pressure variation, so shrinking that heading would make it feel thin against the serif body.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-gujarati: Authoritative is how Noto Serif Gujarati comes across, with oversized e and a counters and gently easing joins. Ozone keeps curves and straights at a single width, and that gap between flat heading and calm thick-thin serif is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-gurmukhi: Noto Serif Gurmukhi is a generous, literary serif with a gradual weight change, like a lightly pressed brush. Its size is worth raising a notch, since Ozone's monoline stems from stem to serif make a stark contrast.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-hebrew: Authoritative describes the body, a sturdy serif with gentle modulation. Ozone's strokes look cut from wire, while Noto Serif Hebrew, a text serif, adds the soft thick and thin that makes the page feel grounded.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-khojki: Flat, geometric and uncompromising, Ozone keeps one line weight through every glyph. But Noto Serif Khojki, a classic serif with short ascenders over big bowls, makes a long passage read refined and easy.
